_comment: Scripted acquisition-agent turns for fixtures/emails/02_price_drop.eml: the price drop that crosses WATCH -> REVIEW. structured_outputs.SkepticOutput answers the skeptic agent's structured-output request (Strands names that tool after the Pydantic model).

questions: How old is the roof, and what is the replacement and repair history on it?
Is there a Phase I environmental site assessment for the property, and may we see it?
Can you provide the CAM reconciliation for the trailing twelve months?

input.note: Price cut to $1.25M clears every gate: normalized cap and DSCR now pass. Diligence gaps remain.

turns.final_text: Price dropped $1,550,000 -> $1,250,000; the deal now passes every gate and moved WATCH -> REVIEW. Skeptic says proceed with questions; three broker questions drafted and you have been notified.

SkepticOutput.summary: The economics clear the gates at $1,250,000, but nothing in the record verifies the building's condition, environmental history or the recoveries the broker's expense figures assume. Answer four questions before spending money on this.

concerns.why_it_matters: The offering memorandum describes the physical property without ever stating the roof's age or replacement history. A full roof on 20,000 sf of small-bay industrial runs well into six figures and would wipe out several years of cash flow at this DSCR.
concerns.question_for_broker: How old is the roof, and what is the replacement and repair history on it?

concerns.why_it_matters: Tenants include auto trim, cabinet and glass shops, all of which use solvents and finishes. No Phase I environmental site assessment appears anywhere in the record, and lender financing will require one regardless.
concerns.question_for_broker: Is there a Phase I environmental site assessment for the property, and may we see it?

concerns.why_it_matters: The stated expenses assume recoveries that were never reconciled against what tenants actually paid. If the trailing-year CAM reconciliation shows a shortfall, the effective NOI is lower than the figure the gates were run on.
concerns.question_for_broker: Can you provide the CAM reconciliation for the trailing twelve months?

concerns.why_it_matters: The rent roll lists lease end dates but nothing about renewal intent, options, or how the in-place rents compare to market. Several leases rolling in the same window would put a meaningful share of the income at risk right after closing.
concerns.question_for_broker: Which tenants have renewal options or have signalled renewal intent, and how do the in-place rents compare to current market rents for comparable small-bay space?
